edges.notes: readelf, objdump, ld, as consume and produce ELF objects on typical Unix-class targets.
objdump and readelf expose DWARF debug sections in ELF objects.
GNU as and ld are the traditional companions to GCC for C/C++ compilation.
Linux kernel build documentation assumes GNU assembler and linker in standard GNU/Linux flows.
Some LLVM-based toolchains still link with GNU ld or substitute lld/llvm-objdump; deployment-specific.
Binutils targets include RISC-V assembly and linking support.
GNU ld vs LLVM lld as substitutable ELF linkers in clang/rust-heavy stacks.
Clang on typical GNU/Linux triplets invokes GNU as and GNU ld unless the driver is pointed at lld.
gcc/g++ traditionally invoke GNU as and GNU ld on GNU/Linux flows.
readelf/objdump static inspection complements GDB live debugging of the same ELF artifacts.
GNU ld links executables against glibc shared objects; dynamic linker is part of glibc on GNU/Linux.
GNU ld links musl objects and shared libraries in musl GNU/Linux toolchain flows.
GNU ld links libstdc++ into g++-built executables and shared libraries on typical GNU/Linux flows.
GNU ld can link Clang-built objects that pull in libc++ when lld is not used.
GNU ld links libc++abi alongside libc++ in Clang flows that use GNU ld.
GNU binutils participate in standard Alpine package build and link flows.
GNU binutils participate in standard Debian package build and link flows.
GNU binutils participate in standard Ubuntu package build and link flows.
GNU binutils participate in standard Fedora RPM build and link flows.
GNU binutils participate in standard RHEL RPM build and link flows.
GNU binutils participate in standard Rocky Linux RPM build and link flows.
GNU binutils participate in standard AlmaLinux RPM build and link flows.
GNU binutils participate in standard CentOS Stream RPM build and link flows.
GNU binutils participated in standard historical CentOS Linux RPM build and link flows.
GNU ld links against FreeBSD libc in typical FreeBSD ELF flows.
GNU ld links against OpenBSD libc in typical OpenBSD ELF flows.
GNU ld links against NetBSD libc in typical NetBSD ELF flows.
GNU ld links against DragonFly libc in typical DragonFly ELF flows.
GNU ld links against illumos libc in typical illumos ELF flows.
GNU ld may link Android native objects in specialized cross-build flows targeting Bionic sysroots.
GNU ld links newlib objects into embedded ELF images in standard GCC embedded flows.
